STORY.HEADING: How It All Began
STORY.TEXT: Pension Portal was born from a simple idea — to simplify how individuals and employers manage their retirement funds. After experiencing the complexity of UK pension systems firsthand, our founders set out to create a transparent, secure, and user-friendly platform that empowers users with clarity and confidence. What began as a side project has now grown into a trusted companion for thousands.

MISSION.HEADING: Our Mission
MISSION.TEXT:
Our goal is to empower individuals and employers across the UK with transparent, secure, and user-friendly tools for managing pensions and planning their financial future.

We believe everyone deserves clarity and confidence in their retirement journey.

VISION.HEADING: Our Vision
VISION.TEXT: To be the UK’s most trusted digital pension platform — simplifying financial futures through technology, transparency, and empowerment.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Get quick answers to common pension queries

LIST.question: How do I view my pension statement?
LIST.answer: Log in to your dashboard and navigate to the 'Pension Statements' tab.

LIST.question: Can I update my personal information?
LIST.answer: Yes, go to your profile settings and securely edit your personal details.

LIST.question: Is my pension data secure?
LIST.answer: Absolutely. We use multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, and end-to-end encryption.

LIST.question: What should I do if I forget my login credentials?
LIST.answer: Click on “Forgot Password” on the login page and follow the instructions to reset your password securely.

LIST.question: Can I upload pension-related documents?
LIST.answer: Yes, you can upload and store pension documents securely via the Document Management section.

LIST.question: How do I switch my pension fund?
LIST.answer: Contact your pension provider directly. You can view your current fund details on the dashboard under 'Pension Fund'.

LIST.question: Is there legal support available?
LIST.answer: While we do not provide legal advice, we link to trusted third-party pension advisory services under the Resources tab.

LIST.question: How do I delete my account?
LIST.answer: Email our support team to request secure account deletion.

LIST.question: How frequently is my pension data updated?
LIST.answer: Your data is synced in real-time with your pension provider’s records.

LIST.question: What devices are supported?
LIST.answer: Our platform works seamlessly across desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

LIST.question: Does the system support multiple languages?
LIST.answer: Yes. The platform supports multiple languages, including English and Hindi.

LIST.question: Is there AI chatbot support for pension questions?
LIST.answer: Yes. Our built-in AI assistant answers pension-related questions via the dashboard interface.

LIST.question: Can I download pension documents as PDFs?
LIST.answer: Yes. You can download pension statements and uploaded files in PDF format for offline use.
